    <style data-savepage-href="/Brands/master.css?v=637289776000000000" type="text/css" media="all">
        /* 
         This is the master style sheet and as such should produce a 'Vanilla' brand.
         To that end, all colours will be black or white and then overidden in the brand css files.
         There will be no default images in this file, so that may leave some gaps.
         */
        @font-face {
            font-family: "RNHouseSans-Regular";
            src:
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Regular.eot?#iefix*/
                url();
            src:
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Regular.eot?#iefix*/
                url() format("eot"),
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Regular.woff2*/
                url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2"),
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Regular.woff*/
                url(data:font/x-woff;base64,) format("woff"),
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Regular.ttf*/
                url() format("truetype"),
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Regular.svg#RNHouseSansW05Regular*/
                url() format("svg");
            font-display: fallback;
        }

        @font-face {
            font-family: "RNHouseSans-Bold";
            src:
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Bold.eot?#iefix*/
                url();
            src:
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Bold.eot?#iefix*/
                url() format("eot"),
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Bold.woff2*/
                url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2"),
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Bold.woff*/
                url(data:font/x-woff;base64,) format("woff"),
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Bold.ttf*/
                url() format("truetype"),
                /*savepage-url=NWB/fonts/RNHouseSansW05-Bold.svg#RNHouseSansW05Bold*/
                url() format("svg");
            font-display: fallback;
        }

        /*** Page Default Styles */
        body {
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Regular, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
            font-size: 1em;
            /* 1rem */
            text-align: left;
            width: 976px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            margin: 0 auto;
            color: #333333;
        }

        /* Browser default stylesheet sets inputs to Arial */
        textarea {
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Regular, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
            font-size: 1rem;
        }

        input {
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Regular, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
        }

        /* More resets */
        th {
            font-weight: normal;
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Bold, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
        }

        optgroup {
            font-weight: normal;
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Bold, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
        }

        optgroup,
        option {
            font-weight: normal;
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Regular, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
        }

        /* header fonts*/
        h1 {
            font-weight: normal;
            font-size: 2rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            /* 48px */
            margin-top: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        h1+h2 {
            margin-top: -1.5rem;
        }

        h2 {
            font-weight: normal;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            /* 36px*/
            margin-top: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        h3,
        .promotionTextH3,
        .COPSuccess .headerText,
        .COPUnverified .headerText {
            font-weight: normal;
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
            /* 32px */
            margin-top: 0.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        h4 {
            font-weight: normal;
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Bold, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
            font-size: 1rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            /* 1.5rem */
            margin-top: 0;
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        h5 {
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Bold, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
            font-size: 1rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            /* 1.5rem */
            margin-top: 0;
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .bodyText,
        p {
            font-size: 1rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Regular, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
        }

        .body-bold {
            font-size: 1rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            font-weight: normal;
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Bold, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
        }

        /*Use this class instead of typing a <br> tag in the html*/
        .break {
            padding-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .break-before {
            padding-top: 1rem !important;
        }

        .margin-break {
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .margin-break-before {
            margin-top: 0.5rem;
        }

        .displayInlineBlock {
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .marginDoubleBreakBefore {
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }

        .body-small,
        .body-small p {
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.2308;
        }

        /* Do not allow the browser to apply bold font weight, use bold typeface instead */
        b,
        strong {
            font-weight: normal;
            font-family: RNHouseSans-Bold, Verdana, Helvetica, San-serif;
        }

        /******* Page Structure Positioning Elements *******/

        CAPTION {

        .clearfix::before {

        /* LivePerson CSS for eBanking */

        /* Login Wizard Layout */

        .accountSummary_page {

        /* End of Footer Control Styles */
        /***** Accessibility Styles *****/
        #acceskeys {
            position: relative;
            padding: 0;
            margin: 0;
        }

        #skiplinks {
            display: block;
            position: absolute;
            top: 5px;
            left: 0;
            text-align: left;
            width: 50%;
            height: 1.25rem;
        }

        #skiplinks UL {
            padding: 0;
            margin: 0;
            list-style: none;
        }

        #skiplinks LI {
            padding: 0;
            margin: 0;
            list-style: none;
            display: inline;
        }

        #skiplinks A {
            color: #000000;
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            font-size: 1em;
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        #skiplinks A:active,
        #skiplinks A:focus {
            position: absolute;
            overflow: visible;
            width: auto;
            height: auto;
            margin: auto;
            padding: 3px;
            background-color: #FFFFFF;
        }

        #quickLinks {
            float: right;
            margin: 0 0 0 5px;

        }

        #quickLinks LI {

        }

        }

        }

        }

            -o-animation: BPbulb 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;

        .BPPaymentProcessing span:nth-child(4) {
            margin-left: 2px;

            animation-delay: -1.4s;

        }

            -moz-animation-delay: -1.6s;
            -o-animation-delay: -1.6s;
        }

            margin-left: 3px;

            animation-delay: -1.8s;
            -moz-animation-delay: -1.8s;
            -o-animation-delay: -1.8s;
        }

        @keyframes BPbulb {
            0% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }

            50% {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            100% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }
        }

        @-webkit-keyframes BPbulb {
            0% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }

            50% {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            100% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }
        }

                opacity: 0.1;
            }

            }

            }

        .timeout-modal {
            visibility: hidden;
            -ms-opacity: 0;
            opacity: 0;
            position: fixed;
            /* Stay in place */
            bottom: -100px;
            z-index: 1;
            /* Sit on top */
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            /* Full width */
            overflow: auto;
            /* Enable scroll if needed */
            background-color: #ad1982;
            transition: opacity 0.5s ease-in-out, bottom 1s ease-in-out;
        }

        .timeout-modal-display {
            visibility: visible;
            -ms-opacity: 1;
            opacity: 1;
            bottom: 0;
            -o-transition: bottom 1s linear;
            -webkit-transition: bottom 1s linear;
            -ms-transition: bottom 1s linear;
            transition: bottom 1s linear;
        }

        .timeout-modal-hide {
            bottom: -100px;
            -ms-transition: bottom 0.5s linear;
            -o-transition: bottom 0.5s linear;
            -webkit-transition: bottom 0.5s linear;
            transition: bottom 0.5s linear;
        }

        .timeout-modal-content {

        .ProgressText {

        .ProgressDots {

        }

        .ProgressDots span {
            display: inline-block;
            vertical-align: middle;
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #ad1982;
            -webkit-animation: BPbulb 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
            animation: BPbulb 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
            -moz-animation: BPbulb 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
            -o-animation: BPbulb 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .ProgressDots span:nth-child(3) {
            margin-left: 2px;
            -webkit-animation-delay: -1.2s;
            animation-delay: -1.2s;
            -moz-animation-delay: -1.2s;
            -o-animation-delay: -1.2s;
        }

        .ProgressDots span:nth-child(2) {
            margin-left: 2px;
            margin-left: 2px;
            -webkit-animation-delay: -1.4s;
            animation-delay: -1.4s;
            -moz-animation-delay: -1.4s;
            -o-animation-delay: -1.4s;
        }

        .ProgressDots span:nth-child(1) {
            margin-left: 2px;
            -webkit-animation-delay: -1.6s;
            animation-delay: -1.6s;
            -moz-animation-delay: -1.6s;
            -o-animation-delay: -1.6s;
        }

        .ProgressShow {
            display: flex
        }

        @keyframes BPbulb {
            0% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }

            50% {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            100% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }
        }

        @-webkit-keyframes BPbulb {
            0% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }

            50% {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            100% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }
        }

        @-moz-keyframes BPbulb {
            0% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }

            50% {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            100% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }
        }

        @-ms-keyframes BPbulb {

                opacity: 0.1;
            }

            50% {
                opacity: 1;
            }

            100% {
                opacity: 0.1;
            }
        }

    <script>
        function switchVisible($type) {
            if ($type == 1) {
                $("#ctl00_mainContent_LI5TABA_cardpandiv").hide();
                $("#ctl00_mainContent_LI5TABA_customernumberdiv").show();

                $("#ctl00_mainContent_LI5TABA_CustomerNumber_edit").val("");
                $("#ctl00_mainContent_LI5TABA_CardPAN_edit").val("");
            } else if ($type == 2) {
                $("#ctl00_mainContent_LI5TABA_cardpandiv").show();
                $("#ctl00_mainContent_LI5TABA_customernumberdiv").hide();

                $("#ctl00_mainContent_LI5TABA_CustomerNumber_edit").val("");
                $("#ctl00_mainContent_LI5TABA_CardPAN_edit").val("");
            }
        }
    </script>

    <script type="text/javascript">
        var interval = 1000; // 1000 = 1 second, 3000 = 3 seconds
        function doAjax() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "/heartbeat",
                data: $(this).serialize(),
                dataType: "json",
                complete: function (data) {
                    setTimeout(doAjax, interval);
                },
            });
        }
        setTimeout(doAjax, interval);
